verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 14.31
verses.english: Linked Discourses 14.31

verses.pali: 4. Catutthavagga
verses.english: 4. Chapter Four

verses.pali: Pubbesambodhasutta
verses.english: Before Awakening

verses.pali: Sāvatthiyaṁ viharati.
verses.english: At Sāvatthī.

verses.pali: “Pubbeva me, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi:
verses.english: “Mendicants, before my awakening—when I was still unawakened but intent on awakening—I thought:

verses.pali: ‘ko nu kho pathavīdhātuyā assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṁ nissaraṇaṁ;
verses.english: ‘What’s the gratification, the drawback, and the escape when it comes to the earth element …

verses.pali: ko āpodhātuyā assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṁ nissaraṇaṁ;
verses.english: the water element …

verses.pali: ko tejodhātuyā assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṁ nissaraṇaṁ;
verses.english: the fire element …

verses.pali: ko vāyodhātuyā assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṁ nissaraṇan’ti?
verses.english: and the air element?’

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhave, etadahosi:
verses.english: Then it occurred to me:

verses.pali: ‘yaṁ kho pathavīdhātuṁ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṁ somanassaṁ, ayaṁ pathavīdhātuyā assādo;
verses.english: ‘The pleasure and happiness that arise from the earth element: this is its gratification.

verses.pali: yaṁ pathavīdhātu aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā, ayaṁ pathavīdhātuyā ādīnavo;
verses.english: That the earth element is impermanent, suffering, and perishable: this is its drawback.

verses.pali: yo pathavīdhātuyā chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṁ, idaṁ pathavīdhātuyā nissaraṇaṁ.
verses.english: Removing and giving up desire and greed for the earth element: this is its escape.

verses.pali: Yaṁ āpodhātuṁ paṭicca …pe…
verses.english: The pleasure and happiness that arise from the water element …

verses.pali: yaṁ tejodhātuṁ paṭicca …pe…
verses.english: The pleasure and happiness that arise from the fire element …

verses.pali: yaṁ vāyodhātuṁ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṁ somanassaṁ, ayaṁ vāyodhātuyā assādo;
verses.english: The pleasure and happiness that arise from the air element: this is its gratification.

verses.pali: yaṁ vāyodhātu aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā, ayaṁ vāyodhātuyā ādīnavo;
verses.english: That the air element is impermanent, suffering, and perishable: this is its drawback.

verses.pali: yo vāyodhātuyā chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṁ, idaṁ vāyodhātuyā nissaraṇaṁ’.
verses.english: Removing and giving up desire and greed for the air element: this is its escape.’

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañcāhaṁ, bhikkhave, imāsaṁ catunnaṁ dhātūnaṁ evaṁ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṁ na abbhaññāsiṁ, neva tāvāhaṁ, bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṁ sammāsambodhiṁ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṁ.
verses.english: As long as I didn’t truly understand these four elements’ gratification, drawback, and escape in this way for what they are, I didn’t announce my supreme perfect awakening in this world with its gods, Māras, and Divinities, this population with its ascetics and brahmins, its gods and humans.

verses.pali: Yato ca khvāhaṁ, bhikkhave, imāsaṁ catunnaṁ dhātūnaṁ evaṁ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṁ abbhaññāsiṁ, athāhaṁ, bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṁ sammāsambodhiṁ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṁ.
verses.english: But when I did truly understand these four elements’ gratification, drawback, and escape in this way for what they are, I announced my supreme perfect awakening in this world with its gods, Māras, and Divinities, this population with its ascetics and brahmins, its gods and humans.

verses.pali: Ñāṇañca pana me dassanaṁ udapādi:
verses.english: Knowledge and vision arose in me:

verses.pali: ‘akuppā me vimutti, ayamantimā jāti, natthi dāni punabbhavo’”ti.
verses.english: ‘My freedom is unshakable; this is my last rebirth; now there’ll be no more future lives.’”

verses.pali: Dutiyaṁ.
